sloka: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यमुवाचेदं विभीषणः।आर्यपुत्रावतिक्रम्य कस्मात् पृच्छसि मारुतिम् ।। ६.७४.१९ ।।
transliteration: śrutvā jāmbavato vākyamuvācedaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ।āryaputrāvatikramya kasmāt pṛcchasi mārutim ।। 6.74.19 ।।

translations.english: After hearing Jambavantha, Vibheeshana said "Noble son, why are you enquiring about Hanuman?"
